g.text: SD02 - CLI text command and shared simulation (UC02; F01, F04, F09)
Static open selects a JLine editor with a fixed status panel on a supported terminal.
Quiet mode, redirected streams or unsupported terminals use plain output, no periodic maps.
Main composes the same Java core, with CliView and no microphone service.
Example assumes ACTIVE and no held input.
Epoch, latest version and revision must match;
action schema must be valid before planning.
Remember resolved movement and accepted text; increment revision.
[scheduled simulation continues while Main waits in readCommand()]
[supported live terminal and one-second display interval elapsed]
JLine serializes panel refresh and line editing with its editor lock.
Resize fits the panel to current dimensions before redisplay.
Between reads, latest state waits for the next editor initialization.
Plain output still prints explicit snapshots and lifecycle events.
Controller closes first; terminal cleanup restores its scrolling region and mode.
A text line gets a new utterance identity; it never calls handleTranscript().
Model calls are asynchronous; all game/control mutations share one application loop.
SD01 covers failure cleanup, SD03 context/repeat, SD04 correction/timing, SD05 recovery.
No microphone or speech recognition is needed for the CLI.
